notes.title: Localization Update v2.8.0 (April 19th)
notes.content:
[h1] The Localization update is here! [/h1]
[h1] Patch Notes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Added the Russian Language
[*] Completely changed the fonts in the game to be more compatible with the  Cyrillic AND Latin alphabets.
[*] Small bug fixes in preparation for the end of April release.
[*] What IS [b] NOT [/b]TRANSLATED:
     [list]
     [*] Poems (Coming Soon)
     [*] Poems in the extras menu
     [*] Settings Menu (Coming Soon)
     [/list]
[*] Redesigned the handwritten font in the journals to allow Cyrillic.
[*] Added a Language Option at the bottom of the settings menu to switch languages. Click the desired language and allow the game to momentarily load the language you selected.
[*]Changed the way the game is packaged to allow a better and faster update system. This is why the update is ~400MB.
[/list]
[h1] Known Issues [/h1]
[list]
[*] Missing capitalizations in Russian translations
[*] Text may clip off screen at times due to the new font style and sizes.
[/list]

This update brings the Russian language to most parts of the game, including all menus and instructional widgets. Support for additional languages is also now possible, and more languages may be added in the future if demand calls for them. 

Additionally, all fonts have been changed to allow for cyrillic and latin letters to coexist with no foreseen issues. This includes the journal entries and menus.

[h1] HOW TO REPORT BAD OR MISSING TRANSLATIONS [/h1]
This is an easy one. [b] If you are reporting multiple bad or missing translations [/b], please send an email to immersivepoetry@gmail.com. You will be credited for everything that you contribute. [b] If you are reporting one bad or missing translation [/b], please use the discussion forums on Steam OR send an email to immersivepoetry@gmail.com. 

[h1] What’s next? [/h1] 
A new content drop will be ready by the end of April or the first week of May. As we get closer, I will be able to set an exact release date. This drop brings with it a new poem level and new music. New parchments will be arriving soon after that.

notes.title: Upcoming Update 2.8.0 (Language Support) April 19th, 2018
notes.content:
The 2.8.0 version of Immersive Poetry will be releasing on April 19th. This update will add the Russian language to the game, as well as support for other languages in the future. 

[h1] What ISN'T translated? [/h1]
Everything in the game has been localized excluding the extras menu poems and the poem texts in game, the latter of which will be translated in the End of April update (3.0, no scheduled release date as of yet and may be the first week of May). It is possible that I have missed some texts throughout the game, and if this is the case, please email me or post the missing translations on the discussion boards. This is my first attempt at translating a game inside of this engine, so mistakes may be present, and I apologize in advance for anything that goes awry.

[h1] Why? [/h1]
The unlockable poems are not translated due to the fact that these are images and not text on a backdrop. I will need to remake the assets and then replace them during runtime without causing any other issues, and I don't feel like I have the amount of time I need for it to live up to my standards. The poem popups in the game are going to be translated, I just did not have the time to translate them before this update, so hang in there!

[h1] What IS translated? [/h1]
Basically, everything else not mentioned above should be translated properly. I am taking this next week to sweep back through it for mistakes (Russian is NOT my native language). The original release for this update was intended to be April 5th, but with my trip to the states, it just wasn't possible to hit that mark, and I apologize for its lateness; I take full responsibility. It's tough doing things on your own sometimes.

[h1] Are other languages possible in the future? [/h1]
This system I have in place now will allow other languages to be added pretty seamlessly in the future. While I don't have plans for other languages at this time, I am open to requests. I do not speak any other languages (My Russian is barely intermediate; Most of the translations are products from my wife), and hiring translators can get pretty pricey. With that said, I'd love to pursue additional languages in between the planned updates mentioned in the roadmap.

[h1] Is there anything else in this update minus the localization support? [/h1]
No, unfortunately, besides some minor bug fixes that won't mean much to you if you have already played the whole game. [b]However[/b], with that said, the 3.0 update will add a new level with some cool new things to explore. 

Thanks to everyone who has been supportive throughout the lifetime of Immersive Poetry. Here's to what's next!

notes.title: Controller Update v2.7.0
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30445890/60fd7139e1b3c5158974d67b7cbeaaaebe65a8c8.png[/img]

Hello players! The Q1 update is here, complete with some awesome new things to play with! The patch notes are available below, along with what's coming next.

[h1] Patch Notes [/h1]
[list]
[*]Full Controller Support is officially here, including UI navigation! Controls can be seen in the controls menu. Hopefully. key remapping will most likely be possible in the future!
[*] XInput AND DirectInput Gamepads and Joysticks are both now compatible.
[*] Added a toggleable banner to the main menu. This banner will be used for announcements in the future and will be clickable.
[*]Included the free open source software "x360ce" for those with DirectInput gamepads that would like to use an emulator in the game files.
[*]Redesigned the mouse cursor to be a quill.
[*]Redesigned the main menu for Spring!
[*]Added a new creature to the Underwater level to make it feel more populated. This will be part of a new goal for this level soon. Watch your heads!
[*]Made the final code MUCH easier to spot in the journal entries by adding additional numbers to the pages. I apologize for the tardiness of this fix.
[*]Various small bug fixes
[/list]

[h1] Known Issues [/h1]
[list]
[*]Microstutter when using a controller and changing movement directions
[*]Photomode can't be opened with a DirectInput Controller (Must be using the xInput API)
[*]Mouse Cursor being reset to default windows cursor after exiting the main menu
[*]Controller start button needs to be pressed multiple times to pause or unpause the game.
[*]Some controls are unintuitive
[*]Some 2.7.0 patch notes missing from Changelog in game.
[/list]

[h1] Upcoming [/h1]
Work has already begun on the second quarter update. This update will be split into two parts, each one including new content (at least one additional level in each). I am currently in the process of creating the environment art for the first new level. It will be slightly longer and more involved than the ones currently available. While I don't have an exact release date planned yet, I would estimate that work will be wrapping up around the end of April/Mid May for the first part and the end of June for the second. There will be several smaller updates along the way as well.

notes.title: Immersive Poetry 2018 Roadmap
notes.content:
[h1] Roadmap [/h1]
Hello players! I have completed a short and sweet roadmap for Immersive Poetry in 2018. Development for the next title is slightly behind schedule, and as such, Thalasse Games will continue to provide support and content for Immersive Poetry in the meantime. I apologize for the lack of new content and features. Some things end up being more daunting than originally planned, but I promise that new stuff in on the way.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30445890/2d11ea3839a26a7e7af124a4254bafa47e549686.png[/img]

[h1] Q1 [/h1]
Even though the first quarter of the year is already wrapping up, don't fret! This update is already in the testing stage and is being pushed out within the next week or two. This is what I have spent the better part of the past couple of months working on, and again, I apologize for its tardiness. This update has full gamepad support for the game, including UI navigation, along with some other little features and design changes.

[h1] Q2 [/h1]
I am taking a trip to the states to see my family at the end of March, and upon my return, I will start work on the second quarter's planned update. This update will include 2 unique and brand new levels added to the game. These levels will be slightly more involved and much larger than the original content (an oversight on my part and a big reason I probably should have launched Immersive Poetry in Easrly Access). Additionally, the parchment system will be more fleshed out and award more things, such as new skins for your menu, new button designs, and new mouse cursors.

[h1] Q3 [/h1]
I am hoping to have the next title wrapping up development in this quarter. Along with its announcement, I plan to release a level based on the Grimm's fairy tales along with some new gameplay elements in currently existing levels.

[h1] Q4 [/h1]
This will be the anniversary update for Immersive Poetry and will include a new level for the game, new parchments, and some new soundtracks for you to enjoy.

[h1] Final Words [/h1]
I hope you have enjoyed this little sneak peek of the planned content! This also outlines when you should be looking to return to the game and try the new stuff every now and again. Have a fantastic March, and keep a lookout for the gamepad update coming in the next week or two!

notes.title: New Unlockables! (Upcoming Update January 8th, 2018)
notes.content:
First of all, here's to hoping everyone had a fantastic New Years! While things are winding down from the holidays, Immersive Poetry will be winding things up with some new content: Unlockable Parchments, along with some new achievements (which should already be visible in Steam). 

[h1] What are Parchments? [/h1]
[list]
[*] Parchments are pieces of paper with poems on them, found throughout Immersive Poetry. Collecting a piece of parchment paper will unlock a poem in the new "Extras" menu (found on the main menu), which can be read on this screen. While poems that levels are based on are included in this set, there are also several others that aren't! To collect a piece of parchment, you need to search for them throughout the game and run into them to collect them. A sound will alert you that the parchment has been collected. More information will be available on update day!

notes.title: Content Update v1.2.2
notes.content:
[h1] Greetings Poets! [/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30445890/efdf9c29ddd4cb930255dfa7ff08efdcad65c893.png[/img]
The long-awaited content update for Immersive Poetry is here! In this update, the focus was around designing and ensuring the new map would provide a solid experience without copying from levels currently in the game. To accomplish this, I borrowed elements already familiar within the game and expanded upon them. 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30445890/7b4050bea13d910721c9c479964139d3a64ffa89.png[/img]

While the new level is an exciting part of the update, it's not the [b] only [/b] one!
[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added the Autumn Level to the Game. 
[*] Redesigned the Main Menu to celebrate the new content and the season of Autumn! :)
[*] Added the screenshot save location to the controls UI 
[*] The Changelog is now available if you click on the version number in the bottom corner of the menu. 
[*] Using the "Escape" or "Tab" keys will now close the changelog (Requested by Leroy Warnt)
[*] The poems on the Boat Beneath the Sunny Sky level now display the poem in the correct flow.
[*] Added considerable more poetry to the Limbo level (Requested by "English Teacher Plays")
[*] Added an Achievement for completion of the Autumn Level
[*] Added an Achievement for Taking a photo with Photo Mode (See controls tab for more information)
[*] Added the newspaper entry for the Autumn Level
[*] Added an awesome new little help widget for photo mode so you know how it works!
[*] Miscellaneous Minor Fixes
[/list]

In addition, I know that the second set of achievements (The ones that aren't "Complete this" or "Complete that") are difficult to complete as there is no direct or clearly indirect completion method. This is intended, and I have considered either writing a guide or recording a walkthrough to assist people who want to complete every achievement in the game. If anyone is interested, feel free to let me know on our Steam discussion forums, or by commenting below.  

[h1] Future Plans [/h1]
The scheduled weekly patches will resume starting next week, and I will focus my attention on QoL adjustments as well as the addition of gamepad support (mentioned below). 
     Immersive Poetry will be receiving a Christmas content update as well, featuring a new map that brings new mechanics and the ability to fly to the game. 
     In addition to this, gamepad support is coming in the near future (I have no ETA yet, but this will be added before the Christmas content update).
Lastly. the next project is still underway, and while it's still too early to discuss specifics, Immersive Poetry will receive one more scheduled content update during Q1 of 2018 that borrows mechanics from said project.

notes.title: Update v1.1.1
notes.content:
[h1] Patch Notes for October 23rd, 2017 [/h1]
This is a "QoL" update with some minor design changes to the underwater level. I attempted to improve some design and direction flaws I noticed throughout the community during the first week. Remember, feel free to email the game's support email at immersivepoetry@gmail.com OR posting in the discussion forums with any feedback or bug reports. Thank you!
[list]
[*] Added "Follow the Right Path" to the RNT tutorial menu.
[*] Changed the Wording on the Third Level's Objectives.
[*] Added "Press 'E' to Pick Up Objects" to the 2nd Level.
[*] All aspect ratio monitors should display all UI properly now.
[*] The hard-to-find objective on the 3rd level has been re-colored and moved slightly to allow easier discovery.
[*] The level's secret on the Fourth level has been moved and made more visible.
[*] Added "Press the 'E' Key to Finish the level" to the 6th Level.
[*] Texture now properly applied to coral in the 6th Level.
[*] Increased the oxygen amount on the 6th level.
[*] Adjusted the boundaries for some objectives on the 1st Level to minimize overlap.
[*] Added more fish to the sixth level (It should feel more lively now!).
[*] Fixed an issue on the final entry where you could end up out of bounds because the cutscene would not trigger correctly (Oops!).
[*] Option to Invert the Y-Axis has been added (Yay Joystick players!)
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30445890/d446df93c0ac5dc77a47ba8d0b7637369fe995d8.png[/img]

Next week's update will include any bugs encountered in the following week along with some small changes to Limbo. Update announcements typically happen around 1-2 days before the update detailing what will be included.

Lastly, the first content update for Immersive Poetry is scheduled for November 23rd and will include one new map with a journal entry. Have a great week!

A new demo update is available on [url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/immersive-poetry/downloads/immersive-poetry-demo-10] IndieDB [/url]! this update includes the new photo mode (Scroll down for more) along with other minor fixes and clean-ups. 

[h1][b] Photo Mode [/b] [/h1]
A new and exciting feature has been added to Immersive Poetry: The "Photo Mode". This mode allows you to take screenshots while the game is paused with the "P" Key. Sliders are available on the Photo Mode UI to edit the image. Here's an example image of how the sliders can make an image look on the level "Limbo":
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30445890/fe0497083484c91e6bbc7dccdcaab196568437b1.png[/img]
Neat, huh?

That's all for now! Follow us on Twitter for more updates on Immersive Poetry and our next project! [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30445890/390a7c2e13b197496d7621ef8ce9db8c7268d88e.png[/img]
